project.name: claude-config
project.title: claude-config
project.summary: A Claude Code setup in one repo: a local dashboard that runs plan files in the background, plus global rules and skills linked into ~/.claude/.

hard.title: Restart after dashboard changes
hard.rule: After a change to apps/dashboard/server.mjs, the page files in apps/dashboard/page/ or anything they import lands in the main checkout (a merge and git pull, or an edit there), run pgrep -fl chat-relay.mjs, then npm run restart, but only when it shows that the live chats run under the relay. A pipeline run in a worktree does not restart: the service runs the main checkout, so its report lists the restart under Open items.
hard.check: A run that touches apps/dashboard/server.mjs or apps/dashboard/page/ lists "after merge: pgrep -fl chat-relay.mjs, then npm run restart" under Open items; a session in the main checkout shows the pgrep check and the restart, or says why the restart was left to the owner.

hard.title: No npm dependencies
hard.rule: The scripts use only Node built-ins; package.json has no dependencies, and the page loads browser libraries (Monaco, Mermaid) from a CDN.
hard.check: The diff adds no dependencies or devDependencies to package.json and no lock file.

hard.title: Public repo: no private data
hard.rule: The repo is public: files hold no client names, private paths or secrets, and the templates in skills/bootstrap-project/templates/ stay generic (project values come from the interview).
hard.check: Grep the diff, and every plan in .plans/, for client and project names, absolute home paths and tokens: plans are pushed to the public repo before they run.

hard.title: Global rules affect every project
hard.rule: The root CLAUDE.md and the skills/ folders are symlinked into ~/.claude/, so a change there changes every project; keep them short and generic.
hard.check: A change to the root CLAUDE.md or to skills/ says in the plan which projects it affects; the root CLAUDE.md is never replaced by a template.

hard.title: Never stop processes by name
hard.rule: Stop a test dashboard or server by its port or PID, never with pkill or killall by name: that once stopped the real dashboard and a live chat.
hard.check: Grep the diff and the run commands for pkill and killall.

hard.title: Tests for logic changes
hard.rule: A change to server or script logic gets a test in the app's test/ folder (apps/<app>/test/) or in the root test/, run with npm test.
hard.check: A diff that changes logic in apps/, scripts/ or skills/*/scripts/ also changes a file in apps/<app>/test/ or test/.
tests: node --test on the matching apps/<app>/test/*.test.mjs or test/*.test.mjs file passes.

hard.title: Docs: current state only
hard.rule: READMEs and docs describe the current state in simple English (ASD-STE100), one line per paragraph, no change history.
hard.check: The changed Markdown has no hard-wrapped paragraphs and no history or session notes.

rules.exampleActor: the owner on the plans dashboard
validatorLimits: restart or stop the real dashboard service (com.plans-dashboard) or a chat-relay process

stack.summary: Node.js 18+ ES-module scripts with no dependencies, Bash, and a plain JS/CSS browser page. Package manager: npm.
